lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Portugal and exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, GeoJSON, KML, Geopackage). The dataset represents approximately 30% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 1 year 10 months and 5% of buildings updated within the last 6 months.
